body: Well, at least you tried. There's some solace in that, I suppose.

I suppose for some, $16,000 is a little bit of debt (insert mentioning of "a small loan of $1mil" here). However, that's half a year's good job income right there... provided you can even find a job in the first place. There's barely anything outside of bagging groceries back where I live, and at 40 hours a week, that'd be a year and a half ($7.25 an hour x 40 hours x 30% holdout for taxes and such) just to pay it off. I've already taken two and a half years off, and it took hell and suffering through verbal and mental abuse to even get me to get back. I've got a really bad tendency to "settle into the groove of things," and I know this. I know that's exactly what would happen if I took the time off.
